what: Criterion 6 of Issue #358: the invariants already proved did not fall. Slice 3 twice showed that a change to the magnitudes of combat drops them, so the two the Issue names are read out separately from the suite that holds them.

base.howObtained: git worktree add --detach ../_wt-358-base origin/main, then git log --oneline -1 in it

wholeSuite.result: 347 passed, 0 failed on the branch; 337 passed, 0 failed on dc15bc2 in ../_wt-358-base, run with the same command
wholeSuite.note: the ten new ones are PrototypeReturningRaiderTests. No existing check was changed except PrototypeSnapshotShapeTests, which got one more sample and an additive update to the recorded composition.

readOutOnTheShippedSeed.whyItIsUnmoved: prepared has no return in it at all — its first escape is in wave 3 and 3 + 2 = 5 is past the end of the party — so the arm the invariant compares against did not move

theFloorOnFlight.howObtained: part of the whole-suite run above; the three run over the seed matrix rather than one seed

whatCouldHaveMovedThemAndDidNot.combatStream: untouched. The naming draw has its own DeterministicRandom salted apart from combat, and the number of CombatJitter calls per wave is still one per raider, because a returning raider is rolled the same jitter as the stranger whose place he takes.
whatCouldHaveMovedThemAndDidNot.waveComposition: untouched. AnnounceWaves still reads raiderCount and raiderMight off renown alone; NextRaiderOf decides only who fills a place that already existed.
whatCouldHaveMovedThemAndDidNot.creatureSide: untouched. Nothing in this change writes to a creature, to loyalty, to morale or to memory of place on the domain's side.
